prerequisites: Having met the requirements of the LESPA 1301 (B1.1 level) course or being able to demonstrate that the student already has the prerequisite level through a certificate or an oral level test with the teacher.

learning_outcomes.text: understand the main ideas of straightforward texts in standard Spanish dealing with familiar issues related to work, studies, hobbies, etc.
cope in most situations in which they might find themselves during a trip to a Spanish-speaking country.
Write simple and coherent texts on familiar themes or themes of personal interest.
Describe experiences, events, wishes and ambitions, as well as briefly justify one's opinions or explain one's projects.

syllabus_topics: Development of communication skills in General Spanish (speaking and writing)
Consolidation and broadening of learner's vocabulary
Grammatical proficiency and linguistic principles of basic Spanish
Expressing one's opinion and formulating hypotheses
teaching_methods: e-Learning support on UCLouvain and other platforms (Teams, Moodle, Google)
assessment_rules: For the June term, a minimum mark of 10/20 in each of the two exams (written and oral) is required to add the Continuous assessment results to the final mark. For the September term, a minimum mark of 10/20 in each of the two exams (written and oral) is required to pass the course. Generative artificial intelligence (AI) may not be used and its use will be considered as cheating. Examinations could be carried out remotely depending on the sanitary situation.
bibliography: Aula internacional Plus 3. Curso de español B1 (Editorial Difusión)
Gramática básica del estudiante de español, editorial Difusion (Recommended, not obligatory).
degree: Bachelor in Engineering (Bachelier en sciences de l'ingénieur, orientation ingénieur civil) - FSA1BA
